name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1487: The bug that started this run was the desktop icon giving two black terminal flashes and nothing else. The launcher is the single point where a mistake presents as the product not existing - no dialog, no log the user thinks to open, just an icon that does nothing. Both surfaces got a syntax gate at v1476; the launcher never did. Two invariants now hold it. ENCODING: ASCII with a UTF-8 BOM, because PowerShell 5.1 decides a BOM-less file by the system codepage, which here is Hebrew cp1255, so one smart quote decodes to mojibake and fails far from its cause; the file was ASCII-cleaned by hand once and nothing has held it since. SYNTAX: checked with PowerShell own parser, for the same reason the JS gate uses a real browser - only the actual engine decides what parses. Mutation-verified both ways: an unterminated string is reported with its line number, and a single smart-quote byte with its offset.
